title: Video Rendering Completely Disconnected from Scene/Shot Pipeline
problem: videoRenderService.js generates a video using a single solid background color (lavfi color) with an audio track or a 12-byte dummy buffer fallback. It completely discards all generated scenes, shots, visual assets, and camera motions.
evidence: videoRenderService.js line 203: createFallbackVideo creates a 12-byte dummy file
expected: Video rendering engine must compose and concatenate the actual shot video/image sequences corresponding to each dialogue scene.
recommendation: Replace the single color loop with a multi-track timeline video compositor that stitches generated video clips/shot images with transitions, captions, and audio.

title: Absence of Real AI Image & Video Generation Engine
problem: The application does not integrate with any AI image (Imagen/SD/Flux) or AI video (Kling/Runway/Pika/Luma/Wan) API. All visual assets are static hardcoded Unsplash stock photos.
evidence: conversationalStoryDirectorService.js & visualStorytellingEngine.js hardcode static Unsplash URLs (e.g. images.unsplash.com/photo-...)
No prompt-to-image or image-to-video generation worker is present in services/
expected: The factory should generate custom visual assets and video clips tailored to the specific topic and character prompts.
recommendation: Integrate standard Text-to-Image and Image-to-Video generation APIs to produce real dynamic shot clips from prompt descriptions.

title: No Multi-Voice Conversational Audio Synthesis
problem: voiceService.js only synthesizes a single monolithic audio track. It cannot generate distinct voice tracks for multiple speakers (e.g. Grandfather vs Granddaughter, Baby vs Fruit Vendor) and stitch them into a synchronized dialogue track.
evidence: videoRenderService.js only accepts a single audioPath parameter
expected: Dialogue engine must generate individual audio chunks for each dialogue line using the assigned character voice, then concatenate them with appropriate pauses.
recommendation: Build a MultiSpeakerAudioComposer that iterates over dialogueScript, invokes TTS with character-specific voiceKey, and merges timestamps into a master dialogue audio stream.

title: Zero Character Visual Consistency Across Scenes and Shots
problem: Across different shots of the same story, completely different people from random stock photos appear. There is no mechanism (LoRA, IP-Adapter, Character Reference, Seed) to keep character appearance consistent.
evidence: Elderly AI story uses photo-1581579438747 for shot 1 (grandmother), photo-1544717305 for shot 2 (grandfather), and photo-1555066931 for shot 3 (keyboard)
expected: Characters maintain recognizable facial features, hair, clothing, and style across all scenes in a video.
recommendation: Implement Character Reference Sheets (front, 3/4 view) and pass consistent character visual embeddings/reference images to image/video generation models.

title: Hardcoded Topic Archetypes with Static Fallbacks
problem: conversationalStoryDirectorService.js uses rigid if/else keyword checks (elderly, noodles, baby, travel). Any custom user topic outside these keywords falls back to a static travel script instead of dynamically generating novel story arcs.
evidence: conversationalStoryDirectorService.js lines 27, 134, 229 contain hardcoded keyword branches returning predefined static JS objects
expected: LLM (Gemini API) should dynamically generate custom story worlds, character casts, conflicts, and dialogue scripts for any arbitrary user topic.
recommendation: Connect generateConversationalStory to structured Gemini LLM prompt output returning a dynamic StoryPlan JSON.

title: No User-Facing Character Creator or Relationship Editor
problem: Users cannot create, customize, or save custom characters (e.g. specifying age, gender, role, personality, visual style, voice). The UI only displays read-only character cards from backend templates.
evidence: public/index.html director-cast-grid is purely populated via innerHTML from template objects with no Add/Edit Character buttons or forms
expected: Users should be able to create custom character profiles, assign voices, and define relationship dynamics between characters.
recommendation: Add a Character Library and Cast Builder UI allowing users to create, preview avatars, and assign voice models to characters.

title: Missing Character Performance & Lip-Sync Animation
problem: The product aims to create conversational short videos, but has no lip-sync or character animation pipeline (e.g. LivePortrait, SadTalker, Wav2Lip, or video generation with speech driving mouth movement).
evidence: No lip-sync service or animation engine exists in services/ or orchestrator/
expected: When a character speaks a dialogue line, their mouth and facial expressions should animate to match the voice audio.
recommendation: Integrate a lip-sync or video generation API that takes the character keyframe and dialogue audio chunk to produce talking video shots.

title: Simulated Mock Evaluation Metrics in AI Lab & Memory
problem: The AI Lab workspace and Memory database display hardcoded quality scores (91/100, 94/100) and simulated evaluation loops that do not reflect the actual rendered video artifact.
evidence: autonomousVideoTrainingEngine.js calculates synthetic mathematical scores based on length of strings rather than inspecting rendered video files
expected: QA and evaluation should inspect the actual rendered MP4 video (resolution, audio sync, frame rate, speech clarity).
recommendation: Update the verification pipeline to analyze the exported video file metadata and playback stream.
